Steve Tuck Is A Free Man. I have waited a long time to write those words. There were times that I thought that I would have to write something else.
See
The Murder of Steve McWilliams  An Indictment, Not An Obituary. The Absurdity of Evil. Condolences from NORML.
and
 The Murder of Peter McWilliams -- An Indictment, Not an Obituary  by Richard Cowan

There are no federal charges of any kind and no state charges for growing medical marijuana. As a part of a plea bargain, he pled guilty to failure to appear, relatively minor misdemeanors. He will be on unsupervised state probation, and free to travel anywhere. (There are multiple levels of irony here as we shall see.)

Steve is a survivor, but it has been a very difficult time for him and many others who have fought for freedom. Steves story is different, not only because it has had an all-too-rare happy ending, but it is also vastly more complicated than most. Indeed, it often seems like the plot of a Ludlum novel. a

Consider just the major elements of the plot.
